prompt_strategy.name: strategy
prompt_strategy.prompt:
# What strategy did you use during the game?

- How did you decide on your strategy?
- Did you change your strategy? If so, when? How?

Please use at least 200 characters.
prompt_strategy.value: We used defining characteristics to make sure we could remember each name. I think mostly we went on what they looked like and what color they were. If there were two that were similar we made sure to either give them really different names not based on the things that were similar, or names that had a similar component but also a different component as well. I don't think we really decided out loud to name things this way, it just happened and we were both happy with it. We did not have to change our strategy ever, just adapt it as the models got more complex.

# How did you and your partner divide the work of coming up with names?

For example, did you both suggest names, take turns, have one person take the lead, or use some other approach?
prompt_working_together.value: We both suggested names, helping each other when there were things we were unclear about. I think I recommended less than them but it wasn't on purpose, it just was what worked. My partner took the lead in typing so that there wouldn't be any confusion about who was typing when and for what character.
